verses.text_en: And thus the Lord commanded the kings and the mighty and the exalted, and those who dwell on the earth, and said: ‘Open your eyes and lift up your horns if ye are able to recognize the Elect One.’
verses.text_hr: Tako je Gospodin zapovjedio kraljevima, moćnicima, uzvišenima i stanovnicima zemlje: „Otvorite oči i podignite svoje rogove ako možete prepoznati Izabranoga.“

verses.text_en:
And the Lord of Spirits seated him on the throne of His glory,
And the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him,
And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners,
And all the unrighteous are destroyed from before his face.
verses.text_hr:
Gospodar duhova postavio ga je na prijestolje svoje slave,
duh pravednosti izlio se na njega,
riječ njegovih usta ubija sve grešnike,
a svi nepravednici nestaju pred njegovim licem.

verses.text_en:
And there shall stand up in that day all the kings and the mighty,
And the exalted and those who hold the earth,
And they shall see and recognize
How he sits on the throne of his glory,
And righteousness is judged before him,
And no lying word is spoken before him.
verses.text_hr:
Toga će dana ustati svi kraljevi i moćnici,
uzvišeni i oni koji drže zemlju.
Vidjet će i prepoznati
kako on sjedi na prijestolju svoje slave,
kako se pred njim sudi pravedno
i kako se pred njim ne izgovara lažna riječ.

verses.text_en:
Then shall pain come upon them as on a woman in travail,
[And she has pain in bringing forth]
When her child enters the mouth of the womb,
And she has pain in bringing forth.
verses.text_hr:
Tada će ih obuzeti bol poput žene u trudovima,
[i ona trpi porođajnu bol]
kad joj dijete uđe u otvor utrobe
i ona trpi porođajnu bol.

verses.text_en:
And one portion of them shall look on the other,
And they shall be terrified,
And they shall be downcast of countenance,
And pain shall seize them,
When they see that Son of Man
Sitting on the throne of his glory.
verses.text_hr:
Jedan će dio njih gledati drugi,
a oni će se prestrašiti,
lica će im klonuti
i bol će ih obuzeti
kad vide toga Sina Čovječjega
gdje sjedi na prijestolju svoje slave.

verses.text_en: And the kings and the mighty and all who possess the earth shall bless and glorify and extol him who rules over all, who was hidden.
verses.text_hr: Kraljevi, moćnici i svi koji posjeduju zemlju blagoslivljat će, slaviti i uzvisivati onoga koji vlada nad svima i koji je bio skriven.

verses.text_en:
For from the beginning the Son of Man was hidden,
And the Most High preserved him in the presence of His might,
And revealed him to the elect.
verses.text_hr:
Jer Sin Čovječji bio je skriven od početka,
Svevišnji ga je čuvao u nazočnosti svoje moći
i objavio izabranima.

verses.text_en:
And the congregation of the elect and holy shall be sown,
And all the elect shall stand before him on that day.
verses.text_hr:
Zajednica izabranih i svetih bit će posijana,
a svi će izabrani toga dana stajati pred njim.

verses.text_en:
And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth
Shall fall down before him on their faces,
And worship and set their hope upon that Son of Man,
And petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.
verses.text_hr:
Svi kraljevi, moćnici, uzvišeni i oni koji vladaju zemljom
past će pred njim ničice,
pokloniti se i položiti nadu u toga Sina Čovječjega
te ga moliti i iz njegovih ruku preklinjati milosrđe.

verses.text_en:
Nevertheless that Lord of Spirits will so press them
That they shall hastily go forth from His presence,
And their faces shall be filled with shame,
And the darkness shall grow deeper on their faces.
verses.text_hr:
Ali Gospodar duhova toliko će ih pritisnuti
da će žurno otići iz njegove nazočnosti.
Lica će im se ispuniti sramotom,
a tama se produbiti na njihovim licima.

verses.text_en:
And =He will deliver= them to the angels for punishment,
To execute vengeance on them because they have oppressed His children and His elect.
verses.text_hr:
On će ih =predati= anđelima za kaznu
da im se osvete zato što su tlačili njegovu djecu i njegove izabrane.

verses.text_en:
And they shall be a spectacle for the righteous and for His elect:
They shall rejoice over them,
Because the wrath of the Lord of Spirits resteth upon them,
And His sword is drunk with their blood.
verses.text_hr:
Bit će prizor pravednima i njegovim izabranima,
a oni će im se radovati,
jer srdžba Gospodara duhova počiva na njima
i njegov je mač opijen njihovom krvlju.

verses.text_en:
And the righteous and elect shall be saved on that day,
And they shall never thenceforward see the face of the sinners and unrighteous.
verses.text_hr:
Toga će se dana pravedni i izabrani spasiti
i od tada više nikada neće gledati lice grešnika i nepravednika.

verses.text_en:
And the Lord of Spirits will abide over them,
And with that Son of Man shall they eat
And lie down and rise up for ever and ever.
verses.text_hr:
Gospodar duhova prebivat će nad njima,
a s tim će Sinom Čovječjim jesti,
počivati i ustajati u vijeke vjekova.

verses.text_en:
And the righteous and elect shall have risen from the earth,
And ceased to be of downcast countenance.
verses.text_hr:
Pravedni i izabrani ustat će sa zemlje
i njihova će lica prestati biti klonula.

verses.text_en:
And they shall have been clothed with garments of glory,
And they shall be the garments of life from the Lord of Spirits:
And your garments shall not grow old,
Nor your glory pass away before the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr:
Bit će odjeveni u haljine slave,
a to će biti haljine života od Gospodara duhova.
Vaše haljine neće ostarjeti
niti će vaša slava proći pred Gospodarom duhova.
